items.source: Uses of ShadowingClassLoader in org.springframework.instrument.classloading

Support package for load time weaving based on class loaders,
as required by JPA providers (but not JPA-specific).
items.translation: 基于类加载器的支持包，用于在运行时进行织入（load time weaving），这是 JPA 提供者所必需的（但不特定于 JPA）。

items.source:
Subclass of ShadowingClassLoader that overrides attempts to
locate certain files.
items.translation: ShadowingClassLoader 的子类，覆盖了对某些文件定位的尝试。

items.source:
Copy all ClassFileTransformers from the given ClassLoader to the list of
transformers that this ClassLoader will apply.
items.translation: 将给定 ClassLoader 中的所有 ClassFileTransformers 复制到该 ClassLoader 将要应用的变换器列表中。
